title: The Morning Digest  -  September 24, 2026
dek: "Flat price rallied 3 - 4% Wednesday on a diesel-export-ban headline the White House then denied, plus fresh Hormuz attacks. The EIA's bearish 3-million-barrel build was shrugged off. Joliet still dark; diesel cracks over $100 keep synthetic crude bid."
